title: Servotech Renewable Power System Q1: PAT Jumps 75%, Revenue Up 58%
description: Servotech Renewable Power System reported a significant 57.7% year-on-year (YoY) increase in revenue for Q1 FY27. The company's total revenue stood at ₹216.29.

faq.q: What is YoY growth in financial results?
faq.a: YoY (Year-on-Year) growth compares a company's performance in a specific period (e.g., Q1) with its performance in the exact same period of the previous year. It helps to smooth out seasonal variations and provides a clearer picture of underlying growth trends.

PAT stands for Profit After Tax. It represents the net profit a company earns after deducting all operating expenses, interest, and taxes from its revenue. It is the final profit available to shareholders.

faq.q: Why is gross profit growth higher than revenue growth important?
faq.a: When gross profit grows faster than revenue, it indicates that the company is either selling higher-margin products, has achieved better purchasing terms for its raw materials, or has improved its manufacturing efficiency. This typically leads to better overall profitability.

faq.q: How does the solar segment contribute to a company's performance?
faq.a: For companies like Servotech, the solar segment involves products and services related to solar energy generation and utilisation. Strong demand and sales in this segment directly contribute to revenue and, if managed efficiently, to profits, especially given the growing adoption of solar power.

faq.q: Where can I find official financial results for publicly listed companies?
faq.a: Official financial results for publicly listed companies in India are typically available on the stock exchange websites (BSE and NSE) and on the company's own investor relations section on their website. They are filed with SEBI.
